# agentic-planner

## Overview: A simple demonstration of an AI Agent taking action through implementation of an Orchestrator Agent and tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)


## TODO: Complete Tools

## Flow:
-> user sends chat -> POST /chat -> ReAct agent runs (LLM + MCP-style tool calls) -> IF a tool is called, THEN MCP server is turned on (stdio for simplicity rn) -> conversation stored in RAM (for simple demo) -> reply returned
